DNSMSG::section
Description
DNSMSG::section takes an opaque dns_message returned from
RESOLVER::name_lookup and the name of a section to extract from the
DNS message. It will return that section as a list of rr_objs.
Syntax
DNSMSG
::
section
<
dns_message
>
(
question
|
answer
|
authority
|
additional
)
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
result
[
RESOLVER
::
name_lookup
"/Common/r1"
www.abc.com a
]
set
answer
[
DNSMSG
::
section
$result
answer
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
